tuples.episode_object: a prospectus offering shares in a toll road's income
tuples.time_place_scope: the Jakarta securities market at Kota, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: selling a stream of future tolls turns a road into a security that changes hands without notice
tuples.evidence_lens: prospectus forecasts compared with the traffic later reported in the operator's annual accounts

tuples.episode_object: a police checkpoint at a contested toll barrier
tuples.time_place_scope: the Si Rat expressway gates in Bangkok, 1993

tuples.episode_object: a motorcycle lane added to a tolled bridge deck

tuples.mechanism: a separate lane for two wheelers keeps a paid corridor usable for the vehicles most people own

tuples.episode_object: a service road built to carry displaced local traffic
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tangerang approaches west of Jakarta, the 1990s
tuples.mechanism: a frontage road paid for by the holder buys the local consent that the main road needs

coverage_profiles.subject: the undersea fibre-optic routes of the Indian Ocean

tuples.episode_object: a beach joint pit dug where the shore end enters the sand
tuples.time_place_scope: Mtunzini, on the KwaZulu-Natal coast, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: the shore end is where a deep-water line becomes a piece of local property

tuples.episode_object: a repeater sealed in a beryllium copper pressure housing
tuples.time_place_scope: the Mozambique channel at depth, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: amplifying a signal on the sea floor is what lets one span cross an ocean
tuples.evidence_lens: repeater spacings compared with the optical loss budgets published for the route

tuples.episode_object: a cable ship's plough burying armoured cable in the seabed
tuples.time_place_scope: the continental shelf off Mombasa, the 2009 season
tuples.mechanism: burying a line in shallow water protects it from anchors and trawl gear

tuples.episode_object: a grapnel recovered with a severed cable end
tuples.time_place_scope: the approaches to Alexandria, the 2008 season
tuples.mechanism: recovering both ends is the slow part of a repair, not the splicing itself
tuples.evidence_lens: repair ship logs compared with the traffic outage windows recorded by networks

tuples.episode_object: a fibre pair splice tray closed inside a joint box
tuples.time_place_scope: a repair berth at Suez, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: each fibre pair can be sold separately, so one cable carries many owners' capacity
tuples.evidence_lens: splice records compared with the ownership schedules attached to the build contract

tuples.episode_object: an indefeasible right of use contract for one fibre pair
tuples.time_place_scope: the landing station at Djibouti, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: selling long-term use rather than the asset spreads a huge fixed cost across buyers
tuples.evidence_lens: capacity contracts compared with the traffic actually carried on the same pairs

tuples.episode_object: a landing licence issued to a station operator
tuples.time_place_scope: the coast at Dar es Salaam, the 2009 season
tuples.mechanism: licensing a landing point is where a state keeps leverage over a private route
tuples.evidence_lens: licence conditions compared with the wholesale prices charged at that station

tuples.episode_object: an exchange rack peering local networks in one room
tuples.time_place_scope: Nairobi, on the Kenyan highlands, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: exchanging traffic locally keeps domestic data off an expensive undersea hop
tuples.evidence_lens: exchange traffic counts compared with the international transit bought that year

tuples.episode_object: a latency measurement taken before and after a route opened
tuples.time_place_scope: the corridor between Mombasa and Marseille, the 2009 season
tuples.mechanism: cutting the round trip changes which applications a distant market can even use
tuples.evidence_lens: measured delays compared with the satellite path times they replaced

tuples.episode_object: a satellite earth station dish left idle beside a new duct
tuples.time_place_scope: the outskirts of Kampala, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: a cheaper terrestrial path strands a costly link that once had no rival
tuples.evidence_lens: earth station leases compared with the transit prices quoted after the landing

tuples.episode_object: a turbidity flow deposit cored from a submarine canyon
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zambezi canyon off the Mozambican shelf, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: a sediment flow down a canyon can break a line where no ship ever anchors
tuples.evidence_lens: core layer dates compared with the recorded fault times on nearby segments

tuples.episode_object: a fishing net snagged on a shallow cable crossing
tuples.time_place_scope: the shelf off Toliara in southwestern Madagascar, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: shallow ground is where trawling and a buried line compete for the same seabed

tuples.episode_object: a spare cable depot holding jointing stock for a region
tuples.time_place_scope: the port at Mauritius, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: repair time depends on where a spare is stored, not on how fast a ship sails
tuples.evidence_lens: depot stock records compared with the repair durations logged for each fault

tuples.episode_object: a route survey chart marking a diversion around a wreck
tuples.time_place_scope: the Red Sea between Suakin and Port Sudan, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: a survey chosen years before build decides what hazards a line will later face
tuples.evidence_lens: survey charts compared with the wreck and pipeline registers for that corridor

tuples.episode_object: a shore duct dug through a town to reach an exchange
tuples.time_place_scope: the streets of Maputo, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: the last mile through a city can cost more per metre than the whole sea crossing
tuples.evidence_lens: trenching permits compared with the per-kilometre costs booked for the wet plant

tuples.episode_object: a power feed rack driving current down the cable conductor
tuples.time_place_scope: the landing station near Zafarana, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: repeaters are fed by current from shore, so a station outage darkens a whole span
tuples.evidence_lens: power feed logs compared with the outage records reported by both landing ends

tuples.episode_object: a consortium build contract dividing capacity by contribution
tuples.time_place_scope: the route between Mumbai and Fujairah, the 2000s
tuples.mechanism: sharing a build cost among carriers is what makes a long route financeable
tuples.evidence_lens: contribution shares compared with the capacity each member later resold

tuples.episode_object: an anchor recovered with cable wrapped around its fluke
tuples.time_place_scope: the anchorage off Bab el-Mandeb, the 2024 season
tuples.mechanism: a crowded anchorage over a cable corridor is the commonest cause of a shallow break
tuples.evidence_lens: anchorage traffic records compared with fault positions reported in the same weeks

tuples.episode_object: a diversity route ordered after a single cable failed
tuples.time_place_scope: the coast at Berbera, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: buying a second path is the only real protection when one line carries everything
tuples.evidence_lens: diversity contracts compared with the outage hours suffered before they were signed

tuples.episode_object: a bandwidth price sheet posted by a wholesale seller
tuples.time_place_scope: the landing point on Zanzibar, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: a wholesale price falls only when a second seller can reach the same customers
tuples.evidence_lens: posted wholesale prices compared with retail broadband tariffs in the same market

coverage_profiles.subject: the cobalt and lithium battery supply chain

tuples.episode_object: a weighbridge ticket printed at a mine gate
tuples.time_place_scope: the mine gate at Fungurume on the Kolwezi road, 2012
tuples.mechanism: weighing at a gate fixes the quantity before ownership changes on any paper
tuples.evidence_lens: gate weighbridge tickets compared with tonnage stated on outbound transport waybills

tuples.episode_object: a handheld analyser reading a grade at a buying counter
tuples.time_place_scope: the Musompo trading market outside Kolwezi, 2019
tuples.mechanism: a grade read at a counter sets the price before a sack ever leaves the market
tuples.evidence_lens: buying station grade books compared with assays recorded at the processing plant

tuples.episode_object: a sack of hand-dug ore carried to a market
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kasulo quarter of Kolwezi, 2018
tuples.mechanism: hand-dug ore joins a formal chain only where a market buys without asking for title
tuples.evidence_lens: site labour surveys compared with school enrolment registers for the same neighbourhood, which disagree on the share of minors

tuples.episode_object: a cooperative permit board posted at a dig site
tuples.time_place_scope: the artisanal zone at Mutoshi near Kolwezi, 2019
tuples.mechanism: a permitted zone makes a fenced site auditable and leaves unfenced ones invisible

tuples.episode_object: a slag heap left by an older smelting era
tuples.time_place_scope: the smelter yards of Lubumbashi in Haut-Katanga, 2016
tuples.mechanism: old slag becomes ore again when a price rises and a new process can reach it
tuples.evidence_lens: historic smelter records compared with assays taken from the same heaps today

tuples.episode_object: a truck queue standing at a border post
tuples.time_place_scope: the Kasumbalesa crossing on the Zambian border, the 2010s
tuples.mechanism: a slow border adds days of cost that fall on whoever owns metal in transit
tuples.evidence_lens: border crossing logs compared with demurrage charges billed on the same consignments

tuples.episode_object: a concentrate stockpile held under tarpaulin
tuples.time_place_scope: the plant yards at Kambove in Haut-Katanga, 2015
tuples.mechanism: storing concentrate lets a seller wait out a price, if it can carry the working capital
tuples.evidence_lens: stockpile survey volumes compared with shipment records of the following quarter

tuples.episode_object: a container seal number logged at a terminal gate
tuples.time_place_scope: the Durban container terminal, 2019
tuples.mechanism: a seal number is the only link between a mine's paperwork and a box on the water
tuples.evidence_lens: terminal seal logs compared with certificates of origin travelling with the same lots

tuples.episode_object: a corridor road rutted by loaded ore trucks
tuples.time_place_scope: the Beira corridor across central Mozambique, 2017
tuples.mechanism: a route's condition decides the export price a landlocked producer can actually get
tuples.evidence_lens: road maintenance records compared with freight rates quoted along the same corridor

tuples.episode_object: a rail wagon of concentrate held at an inland siding
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ndola rail yards on the Zambian Copperbelt, 2018
tuples.mechanism: a rail bottleneck stores metal against an owner's will and ties up its value
tuples.evidence_lens: wagon turnaround records compared with shipment schedules promised to buyers

tuples.episode_object: a port shed built for a single mineral flow
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dar es Salaam bulk terminal, 2021
tuples.mechanism: a dedicated shed is a bet that one flow will outlast the lease that paid for it
tuples.evidence_lens: terminal throughput records compared with lease terms signed for the same berths

tuples.episode_object: a drill core tray laid out from an exploration grid
tuples.time_place_scope: the Manono lithium field in Tanganyika province, 2022
tuples.mechanism: core assays turn a known outcrop into a reserve that a bank will lend against

tuples.episode_object: a spodumene pile beside a new processing plant
tuples.time_place_scope: the Bikita field in eastern Zimbabwe, 2022
tuples.mechanism: concentrating before export cuts freight and keeps one processing step at home
tuples.evidence_lens: plant recovery records compared with export grades declared at the border

tuples.episode_object: an export ban notice pinned up at a mine office
tuples.time_place_scope: the Arcadia mine east of Harare, 2023
tuples.mechanism: banning raw ore export forces a plant to be built or the ore to stay in the ground
tuples.evidence_lens: export permit records compared with plant commissioning dates in the same period

tuples.episode_object: a haul road cut to a prospect through farmland
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ewoyaa prospect in southern Ghana, 2023
tuples.mechanism: an access road is the first cost and the first thing a neighbouring farm notices
tuples.evidence_lens: land compensation agreements compared with cadastral records of the affected farms

tuples.episode_object: a tailings dam spillway built above a valley
tuples.time_place_scope: the Goulamina site in southern Mali, 2023
tuples.mechanism: a tailings structure outlives a mine, so its design is a promise about the next century
tuples.evidence_lens: dam design filings compared with independent inspection reports of the same structure

tuples.episode_object: a dust monitor mounted on a fence line
tuples.time_place_scope: the Uis workings in the Erongo region of Namibia, 2021
tuples.mechanism: measuring dust at a boundary is what turns a claim about air into a checkable number
tuples.evidence_lens: fence line dust readings compared with clinic attendance records of the nearby settlement

tuples.episode_object: a precursor sample drawn at a cathode materials plant
tuples.time_place_scope: the Jorf Lasfar industrial platform in Morocco, 2024
tuples.mechanism: making cathode material near the ore keeps one step of value on the same continent
tuples.evidence_lens: plant input records compared with origin declarations attached to the incoming metal

tuples.episode_object: a water sample bottle filled downstream of a plant
tuples.time_place_scope: the Lualaba river reach below Kolwezi, 2020
tuples.mechanism: testing water downstream turns a dispute about a discharge into a measurable question
tuples.evidence_lens: independent river sample results compared with the plant's own discharge monitoring, which differ
